phases.label: Stage I
phases.architecture: First enclosed settlement beneath the castle; massive enclosure forms the nucleus retained by later building.

phases.label: Stage II
phases.architecture: Added inner brick masonry to enclosure; residential occupation outside the enclosed nucleus.

phases.label: Stage IIIA
phases.architecture: Antecedent enclosure converted into castle; bailey and the town later called middle town founded, with outer enclosure and reservoirs.

phases.label: Stage IIIB
phases.architecture: Repairs after a catastrophe; lower town added and outer wall extended.

phases.label: Stages IV and V
phases.architecture: Classical layout maintained, then repairs and decline.

phases.label: Stages VI and VII
phases.architecture: Reduced settlement with changed domestic plan, followed after desertion by circular houses.

support.text: The first exposed enclosure is assigned to Stage I. The report says its planning formed the nucleus of later expansion; the named castle was created by enlargement in Stage III.

alternatives.text: For the developed castle rather than its earliest enclosure, Stage IIIA is the appropriate construction label.

2.basis: Site dating study explicitly places the beginning of occupation at approximately 5500 calendar years BP. The first enclosed nucleus is the first occupation in the excavation sequence.

support.text: The lower town was added after catastrophe within Stage III, and the enclosure extended to include it.

alternatives.text: The published shallow exposures are predominantly Stages IV and V, while deep trenches reach the original occupation.

parts.no_candidate_reason: A separate calendar start for Stage IIIB is not given in the inspected chronology. The start of undivided Stage III would predate the lower-town addition.
parts.notes: Most exposed domestic remains belong to later maintained phases; the report distinguishes those exposures from the initial lower-town addition.

first_occupation.evidence: Approximate beginning of occupation stated as about 5500 calibrated years BP in the newer shell chronology. Conversion uses astronomical year = 1950 - cal BP; the rounded age is not a modelled start median.

searches: Bisht preliminary report culture sequence, chronology and town divisions; Sengupta et al. published shell chronology; Wiley supplement S4 and author-uploaded article; Bayesian phase-start search.

notes.text: The newer study provides calibrated sample envelopes for cultural stages. Stages III and V lack dated material and their values are inferred from neighbouring stages; these are not independent start-boundary estimates.

coverage.radiocarbon: Individual BP/error/context rows are in Sengupta et al. supporting Table S4, whose file route was inaccessible. Stage envelopes and the stated beginning are recorded, but no individual determinations from that study are transcribed.
